full_retained_record.rule: Preserve the benchmark execution artifacts, released evaluator label, complete TestTracker output, and evaluator report verbatim and immutably.

scorer_visible_non_verdict_evidence.projection_rule: Build an immutable scorer view with a fixed allowlist from the full retained record and frozen pre-run case sources.
criterion_and_target_basis: case-specific initial-state SQL column lists and evaluator model-field accesses in the official 19-file packet
execution_evidence: post-run database state or lossless start/end database diff
forbidden: TestTracker success, passes, failures, or num_tests output values
any summary, manifest, log field, reward, or aggregate that deterministically reveals a released result

comparison_only_released_results.rule: Only a non-scorer comparator may read these results after the native S/F/U verdict bytes and hash have been locked; they may never flow back to the scorer.

native_verdict_rule: Let each frozen registered test have an evidence status in {S, F, U}. Native S iff every registered test is S. Native F iff at least one registered test is F, regardless of unresolved remaining tests. Native U iff no registered test is F and at least one registered test is U.
post_score_comparison_rule: Any released-label/native-verdict mismatch enters separate record-level review. Mismatch alone is not benchmark conflict. Confirmed conflict requires retained artifacts and explicit source pointers establishing that task, target construction, evaluator/oracle, or reward wiring/aggregation checked a different outcome from the benchmark's apparent claim.

formal_semantics_binding.scope_note: The descriptor pins the released AppWorld commit and evaluator.py source hash. The case packet additionally freezes each case evaluator, test_data, targets, and initial-state SQL column inventory.

condition.S: All conjuncts in condition.text are established by the condition's scorer-visible retained evidence.
condition.F: At least one conjunct is established false by retained evidence.
condition.U: No conjunct is established false, but at least one necessary conjunct is unresolved because evidence is missing, incomplete, or non-decisive.

aggregate.F: At least one stronger condition is F.
aggregate.U: No stronger condition is F and at least one is U.

stronger_rule.action_absence_boundary: For a condition about whether an action occurred, absence is F only when the retained action/API trace is established complete; otherwise it is U.
stronger_rule.separation: Stronger results are reported independently. Stronger F does not change native S/F/U and never establishes benchmark conflict.
